do not silently stitch market pages with different cache timestamps into one atomic book
equipment valuation must preserve UID/stat/bonus/rarity semantics; item ID alone is insufficient
merge history alone is insufficient branch-deletion proof; exact containment must be rechecked
presence of a numeric external trader price must not be treated as proof the trader currently buys that item
authoritative completion text can survive after TornPDA has removed the item and cash manifest; completion recognition alone cannot support a ledger mutation
do not inherit a community strategy threshold merely because it is longstanding; preserve the underlying assumptions and rederive the EV from verified Torn mechanics
when a Torn Wiki rule would mathematically contradict a newer staff statement about house/player edge, treat the conflict as a falsification target rather than selecting the convenient source
model casino choices by actual UI decision state; High-Low post-win 100% cashout and revealed-card 50% cashout are different states and require different EV calculations
when community tools disagree on a casino reset threshold, prefer explicit visible Torn reset/shuffle evidence and fail closed on desync rather than hard-coding the guessed threshold as game truth
public helper code is useful evidence for DOM feasibility and research hypotheses but its mathematical state model must be independently checked against Torn decision states before reuse

under a one-bullet six-position without-replacement RR model, extra consecutive self-shots change turn allocation but never improve optimal win probability over one shot; keep this conditional until Torn's actual probability model is verified
